blocks.text: 329 questions: five from each of the 66 chapters, in a random order.

Your first answer to each question is the one that counts. 90% or better passes, and passing earns the badge for Word Formation. You can take it as often as you like; the questions are dealt afresh each time.

exercises.q: Мальчик **ото**шёл от незнакомца, который предложил ему конфеты. (The boy stepped back from the stranger who had offered him candy.) What does ото- add here?
options: Movement out of something across a threshold, exiting

exercises.q: Пассажиры **до**ехали до последней остановки и вышли из автобуса. (The passengers reached the last station and exited the bus.) What does до- add here?
options: Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way

exercises.q: Она **вы**шла из кабинета. (She exited the office.) What does вы- add here?
options: Movement across, through, or past something
Movement out of something across a threshold, exiting

exercises.q: Она задумчиво **по**ходила по квартире и наконец решила уйти. (She walked around the apartment pensively and finally decided to leave.) What does по- add here?
options: Divergent movement in various directions from one center
Completed semelfactive movement in opposite directions, there and back.

exercises.q: Девочка **обо**шла лужу. (The little girl walked around the puddle.) What does обо- add here?
options: Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way

Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place

exercises.q: Мы **про**ходили по лесу весь день. (We walked around the woods all day.) What does про- add here?
options: Convergent movement from various directions towards one center
